LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT YERBA BUENA CENTER FOR THE ARTS' DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND. NO OPPOSITION FILED. THE COURT COULD NOT HEAR ARGUMENT BECAUSE OPPOSING PARTY DID NOT NOTIFY THE OTHER SIDE OF HER INTENT TO APPEAR AFTER THE TENTATIVE RULING CAME OUT AFTER 3PM THE DAY BEFORE. JUDGE BUSCH MADE A DISCLOSURE ABOUT HIS WIFE, CATHARINE BARNES, A DEPUTY CITY ATTORNEY NOT INVOLVED IN THIS CASE AND THAT HE DOES NOT VIEW HER EMPLOYMENT AS A BASIS FOR RECUSAL. NO OBJECTIONS WERE MADE. PREVAILING PARTY TO SUBMIT FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189
